sections.section_title: ADC injected channel y data register (ADC_JDRy)
sections.text_helper: Section 21.6.18 "ADC injected channel y data register (ADC_JDRy)" in chapter 21 (Analog-to-digital converters (ADC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 658.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x080 + 0x004 * (y - 1), (y = 1 to 4)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 JDATA[31:0]: Injected data
These bits are read-only. They contain the conversion result from injected channel y. The
data are left- or right-aligned as described in Section21.4.25: Data management.
